---
title: "multirepo"
toc: true
---

The `multirepo` subcommand acts as a wrapper around the bundled `repos` utility, which is installed alongside `setupmjr`. It is designed to manage local workspaces and batch-process actions across multiple repositories.

## Commands

```
  multirepo clone
  multirepo workspace
  multirepo codespace
  multirepo create
  multirepo <other repos command>
```

Any command passed to `setupmjr multirepo` will be automatically proxied to the bundled `repos` tool.

> Note: The commands `install-r-deps` and `run` are deliberately excluded from this wrapper and must be called directly via `repos` instead.

## Details

The core operations for managing multiple repositories collectively (e.g. cloning a list of repositories, configuring cross-repo VS Code workspaces) are powered by the `repos` utility. The `multirepo` subcommand simplifies their execution from the `setupmjr` CLI.
